biased_nodes.label: TDD

The candidate's CV emphasizes a Computer Science Engineering degree obtained relatively recently (January 2021 - September 2024), coupled with internship experience. While the skills listed are relevant, the JD specifically seeks a 'solide formation en développement web' (solid web development formation) implying a more established and mature skillset.
